summary: Tested SHOT button consolidation and assist picker features in EnhancedLiveStatsEntry component. All 7 features verified successfully: single SHOT button per team, modal with Goal/Save/Miss options, assist picker appearing when Goal is selected, assist dropdown excluding goal scorer, assist stat tracking, goal without assist working, and assist info in game narration.
critical_code_review_comments: EnhancedLiveStatsEntry.js correctly implements single SHOT button per team (lines 2260-2268 for home, 2323-2331 for away)
Shot modal correctly shows Goal/Save/Miss options (lines 1745-1801)
Assist picker correctly appears only when Goal is selected (lines 1823-1852)
Assist dropdown correctly excludes the goal scorer using filter (line 1840)
Assist stat is correctly updated for both known and unknown players (lines 785-790, 1003-1019)
Game event narration correctly includes assist info (lines 865-866, 1072-1073)
